environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with a restricted pod security context. The container's securityContext specifies drop: [ALL] with add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE] only, and the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem. Additionally, the PostgreSQL connection is routed through a PgBouncer instance (v1.21) configured in transaction pooling mode with a custom query_filter plugin (pgbouncer-rr fork) that applies a server-side prepared statement enforcement policy: any query containing unparameterized string literals adjacent to SQL keywords (WHERE, AND, OR, LIKE, IN) that don't match the application's registered query fingerprint whitelist (hash-based, 14 fingerprints registered at deploy time via ConfigMap) is rejected with error code 42000 before reaching PostgreSQL. The fingerprint whitelist is generated at build time by static analysis of the application's SQL patterns. Container capabilities CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are explicitly dropped.
